title: Justice League Unlimited #25
desc:
A VISION OF CRISIS!

The All In saga reaches a new milestone as the post-K.O. tournament Visions are at last revealed!

But first, the league must track down the one precog with enough power to unite this surge of power: the fugitive Dreamer! Will a new core team of the mightiest minds in the DCU be enough to face the future...or will this dream become a nightmare?

It's the oversize 25th issue of Justice League Unlimited brought to you by the team that started it all: Mark Waid and Dan Mora...plus Dreamer's journey to unlikely savior by GLAAD Media award-winning writer Nicole Maines and rising star artist Fico Ossio! Do not miss out on the biggest anniversary event in the All In saga!
